description: M8.5C RP4E2/RP4E3/deployment tester bootstrap: adds spatial_design_generation_attempts and spatial_design_acceptances to the collection manifest, plus the schema_migrations ledger collection itself. No business or demo documents are inserted by this migration.
notes: This file is the checked-in, human-reviewable declaration of what backend/cmd/dbbootstrap's `apply` subcommand is expected to produce.

The actual applied/verified record lives in MongoDB's schema_migrations collection (one document per applied migration, keyed by migrationId, carrying a SHA-256 checksum of the sorted collection manifest at apply time) — this file is not read by dbbootstrap at runtime; the authoritative manifest is backend/internal/platform/mongo/schema_manifest.go's CollectionManifest.

The full 63-collection manifest (all Milestones 1-8 plus every M8.5C spatial collection) is not repeated here to avoid a second, driftable copy — see schema_manifest.go and its schema_manifest_test.go drift guard.

validators: {} — no Mongo JSON Schema validators are defined by this or any prior migration; validation remains Go-side only, matching the existing repository convention. This is a deliberate, recorded state, not an oversight.
